subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Is the PR body's redacted predicate/script plus fault-injected runner evidence sufficient for this session/message-delivery retry change, or should merge wait for full-runner or gateway proof?
rationale: The code shape looks coherent, but the affected behavior is a user-visible recovery path after provider failure where duplicate side effects and lost replies are the main risks, so proof sufficiency is a maintainer judgment.

options.title: Require full-runner or gateway proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs or an artifact showing the retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate tool/message side effects before merge.

options.title: Accept the current proof
options.body: Treat the temporary runtime transcript plus fault-injected runner tests as enough and proceed with maintainer review of the compatibility and retry-ordering risk.

options.title: Choose another canonical candidate
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers prefer the proof or implementation shape from another open fix candidate for the same canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Require full-runner or gateway proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal logs or an artifact showing the retry warning, recovered response, and no duplicate tool/message side effects before merge.
